notes.title: Build your own boss battle in Robo Frenzy
notes.notes:
Hi from Gamescom! We're here showing Robo Frenzy with a feature we've been working on for a long time, the Build a Boss workshop! Players can capture robos and customize them with equipment to make a sharable boss battle.

If we give Sir Code-a-lot a new traffic cone hat...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/7da38da70944d892c16f4b4ae0d83018cb63e909.gif[/img]

... he gets an ability to make a traffic cone spikes when he slams the ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/d3043accd43ced08ff3c9c7969d9c070636c1bc7.gif[/img]

Let's see what happens if we give Alphabit the ray gun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/b1ae8755c4c72db2d468cbe9ccd5717d6f8fa84c.gif[/img]

The ray gun gives Alphabit a laser firing attack!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/6a7318e304e3804621c742f1971d31883c0fcbd4.gif[/img]

Robo Frenzy's Build a Boss workshop let's players design their own boss battle by arming their robo with a weapon and choosing equipment that gives robos different abilities. Custom boss battles can be shared with a friend or all over the world. We can't wait to see what robos players make!

notes.title: Bitsummit's Robo Frenzy demo drifts on to Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/f4a71c39065a405f7317b6ce9c622e19e460e3dc.png[/img]

Hey Battle Builders, we're honored to be part of Bitsummit Drift and we're thrilled to share a new playable demo on Steam! This demo has new weapons to craft, more machines to build, and new bosses to beatdown.

Here's a sneak peek at all of the weapons you can build in the demo:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/4c0be64e904b988199f739f7d1bcc9beb1f74563.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/b0d5f0ee44149f2534f2842439643cfd04fd8b68.png[/img]

Connect a red Spherizer with a pink Explosive Toaster factory to make rayguns, a powerful, but slow long range weapon or link three blue Edgerizers together to craft the powerful Tornado Top. Use your weapons to battle the T-ramasaurus Hex or put them in machines like the Kaboomer cannon to fire them a foes.

Coming to Bitsummit? Stop by booth A-7 on the 3rd floor where we'll be giving away Robo Frenzy magnets!

notes.title: Rise to Robo Mastery: 5 Battle Building Tips for the TGS Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/f2e011181190179fd5c8622496a4188f5fc35a75.png[/img]

Hey Battle Builders, our Tokyo Game Show demo is live until October 2! As a sandbox action game, there are many ways you can crush the rampaging robo bosses in the demo. Follow these tips and you’ll become a master Battle Builder.

1. 🔨Weapon Crafting 101
Throwing punches at a colossal computer? Cute, but not that effective. Quick press LB (or 1 on your keyboard) to build a factory, toss in some metal, and you’ve got a shiny new weapon! There are a dozen weapons waiting for you to try in the demo.

2. ⚙️Factory Fusion
Hungry for more firepower? Connect your factories by grabbing the cable from one factory and plugging it into another factory. Two red factories will whip up the explosive Bomb Buster. Link three blue ones to make the dual-bladed Durandal. Check out our cheat sheet to see all of the weapons you can craft.


3. ⚡Unleash an Ultimate Attack
Stun those rogue robots by keeping the pressure on them. Once a robot boss is winded, hold the attack button to unleash your Ultimate Attack. Pro Tip: Build machines with RB (or Tab to change between machines and factories on your keyboard) and load your crafted weapons into them to pile on damage.

4.🔌Zap 'Em with the Zapparatus
When you get to the Typewriter boss, you’ll gain a shocking new tool: The Zapparatus. Connect this to your chain of factories to make an electric fence whenever you craft a weapon. Try beating the rowdy Typewriter by trapping it in an electrifying maze made out of your factories and the Zapparatus. 

5. 🌀The Bumpinator is a Double Duty Dynamo
Deploy the Bumpinator! Use its bounce to shield yourself from an oncoming attack or amplify your weapon's fury. A flung weapon that ricochets off the Bumpinator does extra damage.

Most of all, thank you for playing our Tokyo Game Show demo! We’d love to hear your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/aacxWxdm]our Discord[/url] and see your best battles on [url=https://tiktok.com/@yytgames]Tiktok[/url].

notes.title: Play the Robo Frenzy Tokyo Game Show demo today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805551/b2b458287113fe8af016e18b77c4fd905bae49fd.png[/img]

Heads up, Battle Builders! We’re excited to bring Robo Frenzy to Tokyo Game Show as a selected indie game and we want to give everyone at home a chance to clash with kaiju-sized robots. For a limited time, we're rolling out a special TGS demo, but it's only available until October 2! 

Brace yourself as two colossal bosses are ready to put your battling and building skills to the test in this demo. Duel with a cranky computer cunning enough to swipe the weapons you’ve crafted in Omniland’s town square. Then, face off against a furious typewriter that’s not thrilled about all these modern touchscreen devices. You can play the Robo Frenzy demo in single player or with a friend in local co-op mode.

Played the demo? Loved it? Found a bug? [url=https://discord.gg/aacxWxdm]Share your thoughts on our Discord[/url] and show us your epic showdowns on [url=https://tiktok.com/@yytgames]Tiktok[/url].

For those of you attending Tokyo Game Show swing by booth A26 in the Indie Arena and say hi! We’ll have some nifty swag for you.
